semiconductor_relevance: High — SELVAC specializes in equipment for high-quality insulating film formation, which is critical for semiconductor manufacturing, particularly in advanced memory technologies.
summary: SELVAC provides advanced equipment for the deposition of insulating films, essential for the production of High Bandwidth Memory (HMB) used in AI applications. Their PEGASUS system utilizes high-density plasma technology to enhance film quality and productivity, making it suitable for complex semiconductor structures.
capabilities: HDP-CVD systems for high-quality insulating film deposition
Remote plasma technology for high-speed chamber cleaning
